{{Quote|Lord Bane&hellip; Kaan told us&hellip; you were dead.|The Sith Lord, to Darth Bane|<ref name="DB: PoD" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''Sith Lord''' in [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Skere Kaan]]'s [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[1002 BBY]], the [[Gender/Legends|man]] underwent [[Sith training|training]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and was promoted with his fellow [[Sith acolyte/Legends|students]] to the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. While he was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], the man fought during the [[Fifth Battle of Ruusan|fifth battle]] of the [[Ruusan campaign]] and was heavily wounded after the forces of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] defeated the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], who did not participate in the battle, found the man [[Death/Legends|dying]] and being comforted by the native [[Bouncer]]s. After speaking with Bane about the preceding skirmish and the status of the Sith Order, the Sith Lord was killed when Bane used his [[Boot/Legends|boot]] to crush the man's [[Bone/Legends|skull]] against the rocks upon which he was propped.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You missed the fight&hellip; [coughs up blood] The battle was glorious. It's an honor to&hellip; fall in such a splendid battle."''<br />"''[Laughs] Glory means nothing for the dead.|The Sith Lord and Darth Bane|<ref name="DB: PoD" />}}
[[File:Curbstomp.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Darth Bane killed the injured Sith Lord.]]
During the [[New Sith Wars]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1002 BBY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] underwent [[Sith training|training]] as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. [[1000 BBY/Legends|Two years later]], the man was promoted to the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in<ref name="DB: PoD" /> [[Skere Kaan]]'s<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], due to the increasing need for [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] to [[Ruusan campaign|combat]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. He, along with most of the other apprentices at the Academy, was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]],<ref name="DB: PoD" /> and eventually participated in the campaign's [[Fifth Battle of Ruusan|fifth battle]], which resulted in a loss for the Brotherhood.<ref name="JvS 2" /> During the conflict, the Sith Lord's [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was destroyed and he was grievously injured in his stomach area, although he managed to support himself by resting on some rocks.<ref name=" DB: PoD" /> Four [[Bouncer]]s&mdash;members of a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Ruusan&mdash;also began projecting thoughts of peace and serenity in the injured man's mind.<ref name="JvS 2" />

The man encountered the Sith Lord Darth Bane, who had been one of his fellow students on Korriban, after the latter arrived on Ruusan near the site of the battle. Realizing that a report from Kaan stating that Bane had [[Death/Legends|perished]] was untrue, the man expressed his delight in being able to die in what he felt was a glorious fight, a feeling with which Bane did not agree. The man tugged at Bane's heel as he turned to leave, but Bane lifted his [[Boot/Legends|boot]] and stomped the man's [[Bone/Legends|head]] in the rocks that were propping him up, revealing to the man before killing him that he had claimed the title of "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]," which had been banned by Kaan in an attempt to prevent infighting in his organization. Bane went on to manipulate Kaan into [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|destroying]] the Brotherhood of Darkness, and secretly established a [[Order of the Sith Lords|new order]] of Sith Lords, limiting the Sith to a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and an apprentice.<ref name="DB: PoD" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Help me, Lord Bane.''"<br />"''My name is ''Darth'' Bane.|The Sith Lord pleads to Bane for help before having his skull crushed against rocks|<ref name="DB: PoD" />}}
The Sith Lord was a light-skinned Human male who had a [[Color/Legends|red]] circular [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] which covered part of his forehead. He also had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="JvS 2" /> wore a set of [[Sith apparel|Sith robes]], and used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]]. The man believed that it was an honor to die as a result of participating in the conflict with the Jedi,<ref name="DB: PoD" /> and attempted to implore Bane into aiding him.<ref name="JvS 2" /> In Bane's estimation, the man was so much of a lesser Sith that the former did not bother to learn the latter's name.<ref name="DB: PoD" />

==Powers and abilities==
While the Sith Lord was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he was one of the Korriban Sith Academy's lesser apprentices, which was noted by Darth Bane. While he was able to survive the fifth battle's conclusion, the man did not do so without receiving a mortal wound.<ref name="DB: PoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Lord was introduced in the [[Jedi vs. Sith 2|second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries, written by [[Darko Macan]]. He was penciled in the comic by [[Ramón F. Bachs]].<ref name="JvS 2" /> The character was later featured in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', which expounded on the background of the titular character. The events of the Sith Lord's death at Bane's hands were identical in the comic and the novel. However, the novel presented a few differences, such as the length of the conversation between the Sith and Bane, and some differences in the physical condition of the Sith Lord.<ref name="DB: PoD" />
